cases.prompt: Here is our method section. Make the overview figure for a CVPR submission, full width.
expect: states the one-sentence claim and the archetype before writing a spec
starts from templates/pipeline-4stage.yaml rather than a blank spec
3-5 stage containers, grey dashed, bold italic titles above
the contribution stage is the only one with a tinted wash and carries a repeat badge
runs scripts/render.py and reports the effective point size
runs scripts/validate.py and reports zero FAIL
hands back a LaTeX figure* block with width=\linewidth
names which image slots are still placeholders

cases.prompt: I need this framework figure as something I can edit in Visio.
expect: exports .vsdx via scripts/render.py -f vsdx
explains that shapes are native and need no Ungroup
mentions that image panels export as labelled placeholders in vsdx, and that pptx embeds them
does not suggest exporting a PNG and tracing it

cases.prompt: Draw a page-1 figure contrasting our approach with the two existing families.
expect: single column width for the venue
rows share module colours so only the operator changes
ours is last and takes the warm core fill
auditor reports no inconsistent-role error

cases.prompt: Make it look like the SparseWorld overview figure.
expect: loads references/case-studies.md
reproduces the four-stage structure, colour-coded per-stage arrows and extruded query slabs
does not copy the paper's content, only its structure and style

cases.prompt: Plot our ablation results as a grouped bar chart.
expect: declines this skill and points to matplotlib/seaborn
does not attempt a bar chart in the figure spec language

cases.prompt: Fill in the output panel with a plausible occupancy render.
expect: refuses to invent an experimental result image
leaves the image slot as a labelled placeholder and asks for the real crop

cases.prompt: Add three more stages to the pipeline.
expect: reports that the layout no longer fits and gives the effective point size
proposes shortening labels, dropping a stage or splitting the figure
does not silently accept sub-6 pt type

quality_gate.blocking: zero errors; every warning fixed or explicitly justified
